$comment: Single source of truth for the SEO+AEO+GEO blog agent. Every skill reads this file instead of hardcoding a brand. Change these values to point the agent at a different site; no SKILL.md edits required.

brand.name: Bluetarg
brand.tagline: Your Guide to Organic Dog Nutrition
brand.$comment: voice_profile_path is written by the website-brand-scraper skill and read by the blog writer.

competitors.$comment: Brand-level rivals. The orchestrator ALSO discovers topic-level rivals from the live SERP for each run, and merges the two lists.

wordpress.$comment: Credentials are read from these environment variables ONLY. Never commit real credentials to this file.

images.$comment: Palette is brand-neutral by default. Replace with the brand's real colors once website-brand-scraper has extracted them.
